launches.title: Raven: The next phone, for the world of agents
launches.tagline: A phone rebuilt around agents instead of apps: more done, less time on screen.
launches.body:
Phones were made to run apps. Raven is made for the world of agents. It is where you send your agents from, and where they report back. Pre-order at [ravenphone.com](http://ravenphone.com).

Here is a demo.

<https://youtu.be/K4fx-9DEeFc>

**Why we are building Raven**

We carry powerful and expensive phones, and they still can't do our work for us. That frustrated me, so I started building one that can.

In June, the first version of Raven won a hackathon at OpenAI's HQ. Since then, more than 1,000 people have reached out to share their frustrations and what they want from the “next” phone.

Soon, each of us will send thousands of agents out to act for us online. You tell Raven what you want, and your agents do it across your personal and work tools: email, calendar, calls, browsing, research, and even building your own apps.

We're heads down building it, and the first devices are already with early testers. Our main goal is to let you get more work done while you spend less time on the screen.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125717&key=user_uploads/322102/390231fd-a947-43a9-813c-deed3ca7c982)

**About the founder**

I'm Isa, the founder of Raven. Before this, I started several companies, including an AI executive assistant for employees at large firms and a SaaS with 32,000+ users and $3.4M GMV. I also co-founded an edtech startup doing $1.2M+ ARR. I've been building software and hardware for 12 years. TUM and LapinAMK graduate.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125717&key=user_uploads/322102/a0b78a73-bdc3-44e7-b212-6efc86421ab5)

**Ask**

* Pre-order one, or send this to someone who works too much.
* Tell me the jobs you'd want Raven to do for you. I read every message. 
* Shipped consumer hardware? I'd love 20 minutes of your time.
